coupe.mesure: Already full on the first frame: 14 titles out of 29, 6 sentences out of 12, 4 cards out of 16, 3 kickers out of 13; product resting or levitating still in 10 holds out of 13.

avec.mesure: The kicker arrives with its word: 8 out of 11 separable, at most 0.06 s apart. It takes the recipe and the start of the element named in `avec`.

ecart.note: offset at the middle of the fade, 8 out of 11

titre-fondu-montee.mesure: 4 titles out of 29 (2024 ×2, 2025, 2026), identical to the hundredth in 3 cases out of 4. Opacity easeInOutCubic 4 out of 4; rise easeOutExpo 4 out of 4.

retard_position.note: the rise becomes visible when opacity reaches 20 %

flou.note: slight starting blur (sharpness 0.58 to 0.68, 3 out of 4); value not measured

titre-fondu.mesure: Slow fade in place: 5 titles out of 29; 10→90 % median 0.43 s (0.27 to 0.71); mixed curves (ease 2, easeInQuad 2, ease-in 1): "ease" curve kept.

titre-balayage.mesure: The word is revealed left to right behind a soft-edged front: 3 titles out of 29 (all in 2025); linear front 2 out of 2 measured; soft edge 2.8 % of the frame width.

T.note: front crossing, linear (2 measurements: 0.33 and 0.86 s key to key)

phrase-zoom-arriere.mesure: 2 sentences out of 12 (November 2020): scale ×7.5 and ×8.1 on the first frame, ease curve 2 out of 2; opacity ease-in-out; blur 4.4 and ≥ 6.7 % H at the start.

flou.note: σ of the starting blur; it decreases with the scale (convention)

chute.mesure: Drops from above with no bounce: 6 drops (3 sentences Nov. 2020, 3 numbers June 2020); easeInQuad 5 out of 6; T 0.20 to 0.27 s; no bounce (≤ 1.5 % H, 6 out of 6). The smoke that follows is not reproduced.

phrase-par-le-bas.mesure: 1 sentence out of 12 (June 2020): enters from below the frame, already opaque, ease curve, T 0.65 s.

liste-cascade.mesure: 3 lists (2024, 2025 ×2), 10 gaps of 0.093 to 0.113 s; each line fades in easeInOutCubic (11 out of 13), starting with its rise: T 1.14 s (1.00 to 1.17; 11 lines fitted from the start of the rise; 10→90 % measured 0.72 s, tail included); rises 21 to 23 % H (extrapolated), easeInOutQuint 7 lines out of 11 (T 1.17 s) or easeInOutQuart 4 (T 0.98 s); at 25 % opacity, the line is still 18 % H below its place (11 out of 11). Lines top to bottom in 16 lists out of 16.

T_opacite.note: opacity of each line, key to key, starting with the rise (11 lines)

T_position.note: rise of each line, easeInOutQuint, key to key

liste-cascade-rapide.mesure: 2 lists (2024, 2026), 13 gaps of 0.029 to 0.066 s; fade 10→90 % 0.42 s (2026) and 0.56 s (2024), tail included; in easeInOutCubic, T 0.75 s (0.64 to 0.83; 7 lines out of 8 in 2026); rise 4 % H (2026) or none (2024).

T_opacite.note: opacity of each line, easeInOutCubic, key to key (7 lines)

liste-par-le-bas.mesure: 4 lists (June 2020): already opaque lines rising from +31 % H (27 to 35); offset 0.37 s (0.362 to 0.377, 4 gaps); easeOutQuart (pooled fit, error 0.005), T 0.63 to 0.67 s.

liste-au-fil.mesure: 3 lists (2024 ×2, 2025): one line when it is spoken, gaps of 1.4 to 3.6 s; new line easeInOutCubic (opacity, T 1.17 s) and easeInOutQuart (rise of 14 to 17 % H, T 0.95 s); lines already there move up half a line spacing at each addition (2 lists out of 2).

nom-remonte.mesure: On a price slide, the name moves up to make room for the label and price that enter below: 5 out of 5 (Nov. 2020 ×3, Sept. 2025 ×2). Name: ease 3 out of 5, T 0.50 s (0.45 to 0.53), +10 % H (7.4 to 10.7). Price: fade 10→90 % 0.30 s (0.22 to 0.41).

d1090_opacite.note: fade of the label and the price

montee.note: rise of the label and the price

mot-remplace.mesure: The old word disappears and the new one appears on the same frame: 3 changes out of 14 (2024, 2025 ×2). The word does not morph or roll (0 out of 14).

mot-fondu-enchaine.mesure: 1 case (2024): the old one blurs and fades (10→90 % 0.50 s), the new one appears (0.47 s, easeInOutSine); midpoints 0.61 s apart.

flou.note: blur of the old word, not measured

mot-glisse.mesure: 1 case (Nov. 2020): the old one rises while fading (0.22 s, ease-in), the new one arrives below (0.20 s, easeInCubic); 0.16 s apart.

chiffre-pose.mesure: 18 numbers out of 27 (Nov. 2020 2, Sept. 2025 14, Sept. 2026 2): starts too big and blurred, then settles without overshoot (18 out of 18). Scale easeOutExpo 11 out of 18, T 0.67 s; opacity 10→90 % 0.20 s (ease-in-out); label +0.23 s from the middle of the number’s fade to the middle of its own (15 out of 18), fade 10→90 % 0.27 s, ease-in-out 15 out of 15 (high-pass measurement, not disturbed by the blurred number). The number never counts up (0 out of 27).

depart.note: starting scale (extrapolated; ×3.4 on the first frame)

flou.note: σ of the blur on the first frame (measurement limit); decreases with the zoom (curve: convention)

retard_libelle.note: from the middle of the number’s fade to the middle of the label’s

chiffre-croissance.mesure: 6 numbers out of 27 (June 2020): grows from ×0.22 (0.19 to 0.37), overshoots by 5 % then comes back (6 out of 6), easeOutBack, T 0.83 s (0.72 to 0.88); opacity 10→90 % 0.22 s (ease-out 4 out of 6); label +0.26 s, fade 0.11 s.

retard_libelle.note: from the middle of the number’s fade to the middle of the label’s

carton-fondu.mesure: Film card: fades in without moving, 7 fades out of 7; 10→90 % 0.45 s (0.31 to 0.78); linear 3 out of 7.

carton-groupes.mesure: The sentence builds up in meaning groups (2 to 4 words), never word by word: 3 cards (2019, 2025, 2026); gaps of 0.6 to 2.5 s; each group fades in like a card; the line recenters at each addition (seen, not measured).

produit-entree.mesure: The product comes in from the right on the cut (7 out of 7 within ± 0.1 s), brakes and settles: 9 entries; brakes 8 out of 8, out-cubic curve (error 0.075); 0→100 % 0.88 s (0.82 to 0.93); motion blur from a 118° shutter (74 to 169°).

obturateur.note: shutter angle of the motion blur

produit-poussee.mesure: Slow push-in toward the object: 11 push-ins, linear 7 out of 11; ×1.27 (×1.02 to ×2.58) over 4.1 s (2.2 to 8.6). Starts with the shot, still moving at the cut (9 out of 17). On a held slide: ×1.02 to ×1.06 over 5 to 8 s (3 out of 7).

duree.note: default: the whole time the element is on screen

produit-recul.mesure: Pull-back that brakes: 6 pull-backs, brake 4 out of 6 (ease-out, pooled curve); ×0.45 (×0.05 to ×0.84) over 5.8 s (2.7 to 8.5).

produit-pivot.mesure: Pivot from profile to front: 4 slide pivots out of 5 linear, over 1.7 to 2.6 s; a quarter turn at most (0 out of 7 beyond); starts 0.2 to 0.3 s after the cut (2 out of 2); the object ends facing front (4 out of 4).

produit-rotation.mesure: In-plane rotation (object seen from above): 6 instances, 83° median (19 to 160°), linear 2 out of 6; duration 4.2 s (1.4 to 9.5). No full turn (0 out of 17).

produit-flotte.mesure: The levitating product does not move: less than 0.3 % H over 2 to 18 s in 10 holds out of 13; no floating bob (0 out of 14). The levitation comes from the shadow, the reflection and the camera moving around it.

derive.note: linear drift of a suspended object (2 films: 1 to 10 % H/s)

eclate.mesure: Exploded view: 7 openings (brake 5 out of 7, ease-out, 0→100 % 1.9 s; spread ×1.5, from ×1.08 to ×4.6); 9 closings or settles (1.2 s, from 1.1 to 2.8; plate settles linear 3 out of 3). No bounce (1 out of 15 at 3.9 %, within the margin).

amplitude.note: multiplies the offsets of the pieces

decalage.note: between two pieces (1 case at 3.15 s; not measurable elsewhere)

balayage-lumiere.mesure: A light sweep crosses once, at constant speed: 8 sweeps over a chip or an edge, 0.28 s median (0.10 to 1.17), width 31 to 32 % of the object; a single pass 11 out of 11; toward the left 4, the top 4, the right 3, the bottom 0.

sens.note: gauche, haut or droite (left, up, right); never down (0 out of 11)

revelation-lumiere.mesure: Out of black: 12 instances, 10→90 % 1.6 s (0.1 to 6.0), linear or speeding up 8 out of 12; a chip on a slide in 0.3 to 0.6 s, 0.2 to 0.4 s after the cut (4 out of 4). Fade-out to dark: 7 instances, 10→90 % 1.0 s. Flash that falls back: 3 chips out of 12 (+11 to +28 %).

sens.note: allume = lights up (out of black) or eteint = goes dark (10→90 % 1.0 s)

eclat.note: flash above the final value (3 out of 12, chips; 3-key shape: convention)

panneau-pose.mesure: Arriving panel: 16 instances, visible 0.36 s (0.17 to 0.50); none over 0.5 s (16 out of 16); the 4 measured curves end softly (out-expo from an edge, ease within the page); 6 % overshoot 1 time out of 4 (a rising card).

distance.note: travel (35 to 62 % H from an edge, 15.9 % H within the page)

depuis.note: bas, haut, gauche, droite (bottom, top, left, right)

dans_la_page.note: 1 = slides within the page (ease curve, 15.9 % H)

fondu.note: opacity fade over the first third

zoom-detail.mesure: Zoom into a detail: 27 instances, visible 0.67 s (0.60 to 1.00: 27 out of 27 within these bounds); ×2.2 going in (×1.45 to ×3.0); no overshoot above 1.1 %, no rotation, no linear zoom (0 out of 27); hold on the detail 7.2 s median.

point.note: detail point, in % of the element

defilement.mesure: Scroll: 27 instances, visible 0.73 s, 59.5 % H (14 to 196), peak speed 168 % H/s (max 791); soft ending 14 out of 27; never more than 2 frame heights (27 out of 27). Flung gesture: 1.72 s (4 cases); continuous linear 68 % H/s (1 case).

mode.note: presentation (S curve, 2024-2026), geste (flung gesture), continu (continuous, linear)

fenetre.note: width and height of the visible area

empilement.mesure: Screens stacking in a row: 29 instances; each new screen enters from the side and pushes the row by 26.6 % H (23.5 to 63) in 0.66 s visible; arrivals never overlap (11 out of 11); gap 1.67 s (0.83 to 10.5); S curve 17 out of 19; no overshoot (0 out of 19).

assombrir-autour.mesure: A black scrim falls on everything except the element: 20 instances, visible 0.45 s (0.12 to 0.71); S curve 13 out of 18; scrim 40 % median (24 to 62 for an interface, 33 to 73 for a spotlight); never all the way to black (20 out of 20). The background blurs with it (σ 0.34 % H, 10 out of 14 with a scrim).

flou.note: σ of the background blur (0.34 median; spotlight 0.78)

camera-poussee.mesure: Camera push-in: linear 7 out of 11, ×1.27 over 4.1 s; starts less than 0.25 s after the cut (9 out of 17) and is still moving at the cut (9 out of 17).

camera-recul.mesure: Camera pull-back: brakes 4 out of 6 (ease-out), ×0.45 over 5.8 s; the pull-back that reveals the whole object from a detail lasts 7.4 to 8.5 s (3 cases).

camera-travelling.mesure: Constant-speed move: 216 shots out of the 309 that move; 4.7 % H/s median; parallax: the foreground moves 1.9 times faster than the background (0.9 to 12.4), linear 8 out of 13.

camera-se-pose.mesure: Move that slows to a stop within the shot: 7 out of 21; arrives at zero speed 7 out of 7; 10→90 % 2.1 to 5.2 s (median 4.4); out-cubic curve.

facteur.note: end scale / start scale (pull-back that settles)

logo-fin.mesure: End name or logo: 20 entries, cut 10, fade 10 (10→90 % 0.65 s; out 3, linear 2, ease 1, in 4); does not move (≤ 1.1 % H, 18 out of 20); vertical center between 47 and 51 % H (15 out of 20); held 2.6 s (1.25 to 4.7). Final keynote card: held 4 to 50 s.

entree.note: coupe (cut) or fondu (fade), in equal shares

coupe.mesure: Over 95 % of image changes: 1,967 cuts against 61 fades in the films, 6,894 against 82 in the live switching.

raccord.mesure: Graphic match cut: 22 out of 22 are cuts; center moved by 3.2 % H (median), size changed by less than 12 % (21 out of 22).

fondu-enchaine.mesure: Crossfade, short and rare: 25 checked, 10→90 % 0.29 s, total duration 0.25 to 0.98 s; none over 1 s; no dominant curve (linear kept).

passage-noir.mesure: Fade to black linear 21 out of 21 (T 0.50 s, 11 out of 21 at 15 frames); black held 0.57 s (0.40 to 1.50; never under 0.40 s, 25 out of 25); fade from black linear 11 out of 16 (T 0.50 s).

fondu-au-noir.mesure: Fade to black: linear 21 out of 21, T 0.50 s (0.33 to 1.27).

fondu-depuis-noir.mesure: Fade from black: 16 instances; short and linear 11 (T 0.50 s); long ones (0.68 to 2.71 s) brake 5 out of 5.

montee-du-noir.mesure: Cut to black, short black (0.27 s, 33 cases), then the image rises from black: soft start 13 out of 14, linear 0; 10→90 % 0.39 s (0.17 to 0.74).

noir.note: black held: median 0.27 s measured (33 cases); bounds: convention

glissade.mesure: The whole shot leaves to the side and the next one comes in: 16 slides (2024-2026), 138 % H (about one frame width), visible 0.70 s; horizontal 32 out of 32; no overshoot; motion blur seen 10 out of 16 (strength not measured).

sens.note: gauche or droite (left or right); never vertical (0 out of 32)

poussee.mesure: One content pushes another within a fixed frame: 7 instances, visible 0.57 s, shared curve (0.43, 0.08, 0.21, 1).

bascule-lumiere.mesure: The light changes within the shot with no cut: 12 instances; the 4 slow switches (1.2 to 2.6 s) are eased 4 out of 4 (in-out-sine 2); the object stays lit while the background goes dark.

lineaire.n: fades to black 21 out of 21; push-ins 7 out of 11; slide pivots 4 out of 5; parallax 8 out of 13; light sweeps r² 0.91
